name: Aurelius Collective Gauze Tail-Wrap Trouser
description: Wide-leg linen-gauze trousers in off-white with rust-dyed block print at the hem, cut with a full-width rear tail channel and adjustable drawstring closure. The open-back tail passage is lined in soft mesh that won't trap heat or chafe geneware modifications. Breathable enough for 35C humidity, elegant enough for Tier 3 client meetings.
functionality: Full rear tail-channel with mesh lining, wide-leg cut for airflow, moisture-wicking waistband.
what_it_says: You have geneware and you've stopped dressing around it — you dress for it.
story_hooks: The block print pattern is a specific artisan stamp from a collective workshop that burned down last quarter.
Someone hemmed the tail channel shorter than standard — this was made for a specific person.

physical_description.visual_profile: Flowing, ethereal wide-leg silhouette with a dramatic rear tail channel—suggests augmentation-ready functionality wrapped in minimalist elegance. The off-white creates an almost luminous drape when moving. Distinctly non-corporate aesthetic with artisanal undertones.
physical_description.fit: Generously cut through hip and thigh with a full-width rear passage. Relaxed and intentionally loose to accommodate various augmentation profiles without restriction. Drawstring waist provides adjustable security.
physical_description.primary_material: Lightweight linen-gauze blend—semi-transparent in direct light, breathable for humid climates
physical_description.texture: Soft, slightly slubbed linen with visible weave pattern. Mesh lining in tail passage feels smooth and frictionless against skin or integrated geneware
physical_description.color_scheme: Off-white base with rust-ochre block print at hem—organic, hand-dyed appearance suggesting small-batch production. Warm undertones contrast the cool white base
physical_description.closures: Adjustable drawstring at waist, no fly closure—designed for rapid access and modification accommodation
distinctive_features: Full-width rear tail channel lined in heat-dissipating mesh
Rust-dyed block print pattern at hem—artisanal, non-repeating
Open-back design optimized for geneware and subcutaneous augmentations
Subtle Aurelius Collective mark woven into drawstring tag
Heat-conscious mesh construction visible through gauze when backlit
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 professional with aspirational Tier 2 sensibilities—priced for working-class clients with augmentation investments
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by biomodified professionals, geneware enthusiasts, and mid-tier corpo consultants who reject chrome aesthetic in favor of organic enhancement. Signals comfort with body modification, rejection of corpo-standard silhouettes, appreciation for artisanal manufacturing
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when purchased, quickly develops a lived-in broken-in quality. The linen creases with wear, adding to the artisanal appeal. Hem print may show fading at edges with use
